reviews.text:
Thank you for your hospitality during my trip to Tokyo.
The staff were all very kind and polite.
The reasonable price was also a plus 😊
It was great that there were many dogs and they could move around freely instead of being confined to cages.

I used the day-use (temporary) childcare service.

The staff were very kind, and it was a very user-friendly place; I would definitely like to use it again.

I will use it again if I have the opportunity.

Thank you very much.

I always take my dog ​​here for grooming.

The staff are friendly, and the prices are cheaper than the local shops, so I'm very happy with it.
It's a hidden gem. It's exactly the kind of place where you can casually leave your belongings – and it fulfills that wish. I hope it stays around forever.
Thank you for helping to watch our dogs, Daisy and Koda.  Me and my wife appreciate it so much.  And thank you for the cute calendar!  We love it!
The receptionist was acting suspiciously and seemed very shady.
I used their one-night stay service. They were very kind and attentive, and I felt completely at ease leaving my child there.
We have a pet menu. Please be sure to bring a pet mat. Reservations are recommended on weekends.
The haircut was done in a way that makes it look incredibly cute and is also very easy to maintain. Thank you very much.

I used their pet hotel service.
I was anxious about leaving my dog ​​in an unfamiliar place, but all the staff were kind and dog lovers!
During the day, the dogs seemed to be able to freely play with other dogs in a spacious grooming room. My dog ​​seemed to enjoy playing with the other dogs.
If I need to leave my dog ​​in Tokyo again, I wouldn't want to use anything else.

Please note that they only accept cash payments.
They are very kind and helpful, and you can check their updates on Instagram, so you can entrust them with confidence.
